verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a probe noting an official CLI documented at the PowerShell scripting overview. That points to a first-party scripting tool, but the pack never describes it as built in or shows it automating repetitive tasks. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that PowerShell ships built into Windows, documented task-automation workflows (scripts, scheduling, triggers), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can automate repetitive tasks using a built-in automation/scripting tool
